target: OpenVM program-image size vs prove-app wall-clock
headline: image costs ~0.04 s/MB, not the documented 0.25 s/MB (~6x overstated)
isolation: both arms read the same hint blobs and execute the same instructions; app proofs are byte-identical. Only the unused 43 MB TINV_WORDS table differs.

corrects.documented: 0.25 s/MB (alp-openvm/MANIFEST.md, OPTIMIZATIONS.md): '92 MB vmexe costs ~16 s more than 27.7 MB'
corrects.suspected_cause: measured with the build/keygen path included, which is worth ~18 s on its own (see 2026-09-11-recursion-quasar-direct-preprocessed)
consequences: strategy D's image saving is worth ~2 s, not ~10 s; its real value is -17 M instructions at 1024 sigs
MAX_LOG_COLS=18 (~179 MB) would cost ~3.4 s, not ~21 s — still the worst lever, but on instruction grounds not timing
strategy M's ~86 MB image saving is worth ~3.4 s against a 38% larger blob

not_comparable_to.reason: measured with the build path in the loop
